<size=40><color=Title>Seraphic Duo</color></size>
When casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 4</color>, enter <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> for {1}s. 
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Overture</color></size>
When Aemeath is in <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> and the <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> is no less than {0} points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Overture</color> at the cost of {29} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Switch into the Mech form after casting this skill and exit <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period of time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Encore</color></size>
In the Mech form, when in <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> and the <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> is no less than {0} points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Encore</color> at the cost of {29} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Switch back to Aemeath and exit the <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> state. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode</color></size>
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, when Resonators in the team respond to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>, inflict <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> on the target for {4}s, stacking up to {3} times.
<size=10></size>
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, when Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, inflict <SapTag=5>{5}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=5} of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> for {7}s, stacking up to {6} times.
While in combat, when the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on targets near the active Resonator reaches {8} stacks, inflict {9} stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>. If the targets have more than {10} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, trigger <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> based on their max stack limit and remove all of their stacks.
<size=10></size>
In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> when the following skills deal damage. The same skill can only trigger this effect on the same target once every {27}s:
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3 & 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3 & 4</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Songs Across the Universe</color>, and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color>.
<size=10></size>
Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> removes <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> stacks on nearby targets and additionally deals {11} instances of <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>, each time to a random target within range. For each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> removed from a target, the DMG Multiplier of the additional instances of Tune Rupture DMG triggered by <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> against the target is increased by {12}. This effect lasts for {28}s. The target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> does not affect the triggering of these instances of Tune Rupture DMG.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> removes the <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> stacks on targets if they are inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>, and trigger the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the target based on its max stack limit without removing its stacks. Each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> removed from the target increases the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the main target by {13}.
<size=10></size>
When in <color=Highlight>Stardust Resonance</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> additionally deal {14} instances of <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>.
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> triggered by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> on the main target is additionally increased by {15}. The DMG Multiplier increase effect is stackable with that provided by <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Starburst</color></size>
Active in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>. Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> to targets within range that are affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>, considered Tune Rupture DMG.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Starflux Thrust</color></size>
When in the Mech form and <color=Highlight><te href=121009>Starflux</te></color> is more than {16}, use the Utility button to cast <color=Highlight>Starflux Thrust</color> and soar in the air by continuously consuming <color=Highlight><te href=121009>Starflux</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Synchronization Rate</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color> is capped at {17} points.
- Dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Mech</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Mech</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>, and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color> recovers <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
- Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Songs Across the Universe</color> and <color=Highlight>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color> recovers {18} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> recovers {19} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
- When in <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> at the same time, casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II</color> recovers {21} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Rate</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color> is capped at {22} points.
- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> recovers {23} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.
- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> recovers {24} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.
- When in <color=Highlight>Starlume Acceleration</color>, casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> additionally recovers {25} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Starflux</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Starflux</color> is capped at {26} points.
<color=Highlight>Starflux</color> recovers naturally over time.

Ở Cấp Liên Minh <color=HighlightB>20, 40 và 60</color>, bạn phải hoàn thành <color=HighlightB>Nhiệm Vụ Thăng Hoa Giai Đoạn SOL3</color> để tiếp tục tăng Cấp Liên Minh và/hoặc Giai Đoạn SOL3.
 
Bạn có thể hạ thấp hoặc tăng lại Giai Đoạn SOL3 <color=HighlightB>mỗi 12 giờ</color>.
